## Objective

Generate YAML specification files from the codebase and write them to `docs.specs/`.

Output structure:
```
docs.specs/
├── system.yaml
├── domain/
│   └── [entity]/
│       ├── [entity].yaml
│       └── actions/
│           └── [action].yaml
├── tasks/
│   └── [task].yaml
├── external-services/
│   └── [service].yaml
└── apps/
    └── [app]/
        └── [app].yaml
```

## Approach

1) Read `.specs/overview.md` to understand the system architecture. Write a brief explanation of what the system is in the Notes section.
2) Read `.specs/artifacts.csv` to get the list of artifacts to generate specs for.
3) For each artifact, generate the corresponding `.yaml` spec file.

## Detailed Plan

Generate spec files for each artifact in `.specs/artifacts.csv`. Update this checklist as you progress:

- [ ] Generate spec files for each artifact
